TEXT: After parting with Kuroneko and Saori, on the way home...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah! I just remembered!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What are you raising your voice for? Did you forget something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Not that. Have you completed "SisSis"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: About that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: What? Don't tell me you haven't played it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: T-That's not it!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Then what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: "SisSis"... It's a great game!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Hmm, so you haven't played it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, look...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I can't believe it. Why haven't you played it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: How long do you think it has been since I lent you "SisSis"?
N-Not good...
Looks like I've incurred her wrath...
If I don't do anything soon...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, I've played "Miyabi's route".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That route was really great～

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Wasn't that the one I played with you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: L-Look... I'm preparing for entrance exams...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: What's that? I can't believe it. "Rinko-rin's route" is still---

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: --No, never mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Nothing at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: To think you didn't play "SisXSis"...
Oh?
I was ready to withstand at least one roundhouse kick but...
But her reaction is mild...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Anyway, I'll play it properly later...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Shut up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Besides, why haven't you played it? Isn't it normal to go into other routes after completing Miyabi's?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't usually play games. You know that, don't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hah?! That reason is not acceptable!
I know full well that she won't accept a legitimate claim.
As usual, Kirino will lose her temper--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ahhh, that...
It doesn't feel like I can say I didn't.
I don't think a sound argument can get through to her.
What could be most suitable to trick her...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You haven't, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, I played it yesterday.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Lies.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's not a lie!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yesterday, when I came back home, I started "Rinko's route"...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: If you admit that it's a lie right now, I may forgive you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...It's a lie!
As expected, Kirino's complexion changed in a flash.
But, strangely, she looks pained; is it my imagination?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So... you're not forgiving me at all...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: What I meant was that I'd forgive your lying.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I won't forgive you for not playing "SisSis" though.
